offers.sn: About Wavin Orbia Building & Infrastructure Business: What if your work could improve how water moves, how cities adapt, and how buildings perform every day? At Wavin, Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, this is what we do.
offers.rq: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related field. Backed by more than 70 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by ensuring safe and efficient water supply, sanitation and hygiene, climate-resilient cities, and better building performance.
